newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs mixed, short covering in Belvieu.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs mixed, short covering in Belvieu.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in moderate activity on Friday as players came out to fill supply requirements following Thursday's lower values.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was up a half cent to between 34.50/34.75 cents a gallon, recovering from yesterday's fall.
Players said when propane dipped below 34.50 cents shorts came out to cover positions, pressuring the market back up.
Conway, Kansas, material was up a half cent at 34.50 cents, mostly due to firmer crude oil futures.
Belvieu normal butane was up a quarter cent and Conway was down at 37.25 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
